messages:
maria_support: Heads-up: incoming support ticket (ACME) asking for streaming tool/function call lifecycle events + a final validated JSON envelope. They need partial tool_call chunks so their UI can show progress and a server-side schema check for the final payload.

alex_engineer: Quick clarifying Qs: do they want explicit event frames (tool_call_start/chunk/end) or token-level embeds? Also want sequence numbers and a trace_id for log reconciliation. From infra POV this needs framing changes + SDK updates.

kai_sales: ACME is ~120k ARR and evaluating Dedicated. They say this is an important checklist item for procurement. Recommend we prioritize spike.

jason_product: Proposed next steps: 2-week spike to define wire format and perf impact, then iterate implementation if spike greenlights. Acceptance criteria: documented event model, SDK snippets, backcompat for non-streaming clients, perf regression within target, canary + rollback plan.

deploybot: Created ticket INF-8721 (spike) assigned to alex_engineer -> https://go.redwood.ai/INF-8721

maria_support: I'll grab sample payloads and the customer's schema. ETA 3 business days.

alex_engineer: I'll start the spike doc with a minimal SSE-like frame sketch (type, seq, trace_id, payload) and perf tests. Keeping this opt-in (stream_events=true) and server-side validation per-customer.

jason_product: OK, starting Spike (P1 for ACME-driven backlog). Reassess post-spike for broader roadmap. Marking triaged. :thumbsup:
